name: AXM Prompt Vault
summary: Local-first prompt, template, model-role, provider-note, and research routing vault.
notes: Stores prompt cards, model-role tags, provider notes, reusable templates, research notes, and handoff packets through the shared AXM spine. ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, local models, future models, and human helpers are examples/routes, not the whole structure. TEST only.
no_fake_done: Prompt quality is not proven by storing it.
Role/provider recommendations are starting routing tags, not final truth.
Automatic prompt testing/evaluation is not built in v0.1.
Registry link is page-runtime local in v0.1, not persistent server-wide yet.
